summary: P1 review (Service Hub design-exterior/arhitectura + Theme Manager) tested end-to-end. Backend 18/18 pytest passed (content, leads with dual-write+triage score, admin CRUD, auth guards, unified leads, experience-profile PUT/restore, site menu). Frontend E2E: both /design-exterior and /arhitectura pages render fully (7 journey chips, 3 phases with 9/10 steps respectively, 8 highlight items, 6 ecosystem links, 5 FAQ, 4 SEO articles). Lead form submits successfully and shows sh-form-success. Public menu Servicii dropdown correctly navigates to /design-exterior and /arhitectura (no stale /marketplace?categorie links). Theme Manager E2E validated: PUT default_theme=light for client → clean-context client login auto-applies light (data-theme=light, no dark class); manual toggle sets pm_theme_source=user and flips to dark; reload keeps user choice (not overridden by role profile). default_theme='system' restored for client role at the end. /design-interior regression PASSED.

minor.issue: DEFAULT_MENU still contains stale /marketplace?categorie=design-exterior and /marketplace?categorie=arhitectura hrefs. DB is correctly updated with /design-exterior and /arhitectura, but an admin 'reset menu' action would revert to the stale URLs. Update DEFAULT_MENU lines 25-26 to match the new hrefs.

action_items: (minor) Update site_menu.py DEFAULT_MENU (lines 25-26) to use /design-exterior and /arhitectura so that admin reset-menu preserves the new routes.
critical_code_review_comments: service_hub.py is well-scoped (~100 lines, generic slug-based, allowed-keys allowlist on PUT, dual-write into unified leads). Good.
ServiceHubLanding.jsx is a single 295-line generic component reused by both slugs — good DRY.
ThemeContext.applyRoleTheme correctly guards against overriding user choice via pm_theme_source=user localStorage flag. RoleThemeApplier only applies non-'system' themes. Clean implementation.
site_menu.py DEFAULT_MENU is out of sync with persisted DB values (stale marketplace URLs) — see minor issue.
seed_data_creation: Test leads persisted with TEST_ prefix in service_leads + unified leads collection (source=design_exterior/arhitectura, score=45/warm, 20/nurture). Restored default_theme='system' for client role.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Service Hub uses a generic slug-based pattern (SERVICES = {'design-exterior': EXTERIOR, 'arhitectura': ARHITECTURA}). Frontend uses one component ServiceHubLanding.jsx wired via <Route path='/design-exterior' element={<ServiceHubLanding slug='design-exterior' />}. Theme Manager E2E requires clearing cookies AND localStorage before client login to observe applyRoleTheme in effect. Response for /api/admin/leads uses key 'leads' (not 'items'). Tour overlay appears on client dashboard and can intercept clicks — use Escape or 'Sari peste' to dismiss before UI interactions.
